title: A separable closure of a finite field is an algebraic closure
statement: Let $K$ be a finite field [def-weil-finite-field-q-elements] and let $\Omega/K$ be a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure]. Then $\Omega/K$ is an algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure].

source.place: Tag 030Z, label lemma-perfect: finite fields have surjective characteristic-power Frobenius; perfect-field specialization to a separable closure. The precise specialization is Mathlib IsSepClosure.isAlgClosure_of_perfectField (FieldTheory/IsSepClosed.lean:244), using PerfectField.ofFinite (FieldTheory/Perfect.lean:308).
